pipelines.name: dv_loan_account
pipelines.description: Daily (T-3) pipeline collecting loan account information for all loan accounts owned by MyMo users. Four steps: 1) FTP shell script -- retrieve MYMO_LOAN_YYYYMMDD.TXT, land in HDFS raw. 2) datalake-dv-loan-validator (Spark) -- checks column count/types/duplicates/nulls/co_owner format/account-number length, moves file to HDFS cleansed. 3) datalake-dv-loan-processor (Spark) -- reads the cleansed file, compares current vs. previous-day data, pads account numbers, writes an unsafe (raw PII) and a safe (MD5-hashed account_number/auto_payment_account_number) Hive table. 4) datalake-loan-single-view-processor (Spark) -- reads the Hive loan table and writes aggregated per-customer loan fields into the shared customer-single-view HBase table.
